title: TEMPUS
tagline: Time continues, whatever happens around the table.
description:
A restaurant pavilion in a desert landscape, arranged around one monumental hourglass. Behind the transparent enclosure, falling sand gives visible form to something usually unnoticed: time continues while guests talk, eat, pause and watch.

The central hourglass is conceived as a shared presence rather than a timer for individual tables. It does not direct the pace of the meal. The sound concept adds a faint rustle of sand, noticed most clearly in the pauses between conversations.

The visual direction combines curved glass, bronze-toned structural ribs, a dark reflective floor, soft taupe seating and pale table linen. Amber light connects the sand, the bar and the desert sunset, while low table lighting keeps the scale intimate beneath the large enclosure.
